official_definition: When your "Scalostle" family Brave Spirit attacks, you can send three cores from any of your "Nuadha" Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit. When you've done so, unless the opponent discards a Magic card from their Hand, for each differently named "Scalostle" family Brave you control, send an opposing Life to the Trash.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Silver Arm Unleash] or [Silver Arm Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Silver Arm Unleash]", "give [Silver Arm Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
